correctness.rationale: With N=mq, g(j)=1+z delta_0(j), z!=0 and L={0,q,...,(m-1)q}, roots-of-unity summation forces the frame operator to decompose into m Hermitian q-by-q residue blocks. Each block uses global k=|K| and a 0/1 retained translation vector. If >=2 erased sites in one class, a zero-sum vector on the absent coordinates lies in the kernel. A full class has spectrum u (q-1 times) and rho=u+q(k+2 Re z). A one-erasure class has u (q-2 times) plus lambda±, whose 2x2 restriction has trace qk+2(q-1)Re z+u and determinant u(k-q+1)>0, u=|z|². Positivity and multiplicities imply exactly C(m,e)q^e viable erasure sets and isospectrality for fixed e. Off-diagonal scalarity gives tightness only e=0, Re z=-N/2 or (m,q,e,z)=(2,2,2,-2). Independent dense spectra checked 432 masks/parameter instances; finite checks corroborate the all-m,q proof.
